veranderings.blok: Warm in elke maand van die jaar
veranderings.rede: The usual Afrikaans order for this term is 'gemiddelde maandelikse temperatuur' (average monthly temperature); the meaning is unchanged.

veranderings.voor: Sy natuurlike plantegroei staan in lae
veranderings.na: Die streek se natuurlike plantegroei staan in lae
veranderings.rede: 'Sy' must reach back past a sentence whose subject is 'die temperature', so naming the region makes the reference clear.
